intervals.label: KASCADE-Grande operation
intervals.note: "KASCADE-Grande has started combined data acquisition with all detector components since the end of 2003." End: "stopped finally the active data acquisition of all its components ... end of 2012" (Haungs et al., arXiv:1504.06696). The December 2003 to March 2009 range quoted is the span of the analysed data set; operation continued to the end of 2012.
intervals.quote: The data presented here were taken from December 2003 to March 2009

intervals.label: data acquisition stopped
intervals.note: Start is the month the paper gives ("end of 2012").
intervals.quote: KASCADE and its extension KASCADE-Grande stopped finally the active data acquisition of all its components including the radio EAS experiment LOPES end of 2012 after more than 20 years of data taking

name: Grande array with the KASCADE detectors

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: the sources give the array position only to 0.1 degree.
placements.quote: The experiment was situated on site of the former Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe (now Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, KIT, 49,1°N, 8,4°O) at 110m a.s.l

summary.plain: Thirty-seven scintillator stations spread over about half a square kilometre, running together with the original KASCADE detectors.
summary.technical: KASCADE-Grande: Grande array (37 stations of 10 m2, 700 m × 700 m) plus the KASCADE array, muon tracking detector and calorimeter; triggered by the Piccolo cluster for full efficiency above about 1016 eV.

technology.locator: arXiv:1107.5885, p. 2, introduction (paragraph describing the KASCADE-Grande layout, beside Fig. 1)

technology.value: Array of 37 scintillator stations (10 m2 each) spread over 700 m × 700 m, operated together with the KASCADE detectors.
